mapper.select: WITH usage_data AS (SELECT account_id,account_ingredient_product_id,MAX(CASE WHEN movement_type='OUT' THEN movement_at END) last_out_at,ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type='OUT' AND movement_at>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE,INTERVAL COALESCE(#{average_days},14) DAY) THEN quantity_delta ELSE 0 END))/GREATEST(COALESCE(#{average_days},14),1) avg_daily_usage FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_movement GROUP BY account_id,account_ingredient_product_id) SELECT b.*,ap.safe_stock_base_qty,ap.max_stock_base_qty,ap.lead_time_days,p.ingredient_id,p.product_name,p.supplier_item_code,p.order_unit,p.base_qty package_base_qty,s.supplier_name,ph.purchase_price,u.avg_daily_usage,u.last_out_at, CASE WHEN b.current_base_qty<COALESCE(#{required_base_qty},0) THEN 'RED' WHEN b.current_base_qty<COALESCE(u.avg_daily_usage,0)*ap.lead_time_days+ap.safe_stock_base_qty THEN 'ORANGE' WHEN u.last_out_at IS NULL AND ap.max_stock_base_qty>0 AND b.current_base_qty/ap.max_stock_base_qty<=0.30 THEN 'YELLOW' ELSE 'GREEN' END stock_status FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance b JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap ON ap.account_ingredient_product_id=b.account_ingredient_product_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=ap.supplier_product_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=p.supplier_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_price_history ph ON ph.supplier_product_id=p.supplier_product_id AND ph.effective_to IS NULL LEFT JOIN usage_data u ON u.account_id=b.account_id AND u.account_ingredient_product_id=b.account_ingredient_product_id WHERE b.account_id=#{account_id} AND b.inventory_balance_id=#{inventory_balance_id} ORDER BY FIELD(stock_status,'RED','ORANGE','YELLOW','GREEN'),p.product_name
SELECT * FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_movement WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND account_ingredient_product_id=#{account_ingredient_product_id} ORDER BY movement_at DESC
